+		}
+	}
+	for _, ck := range c.cookies {
+		if ck.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("cookie name must not be empty")
+		}
+		if ck.TTL != nil {
+			if _, err := parseCookieTTL(*ck.TTL); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, q := range c.queryParameters {
+		if q.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("query parameter name must not be empty")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, f := range c.filterState {
+		if f.Key == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("filterState key must not be empty")
+		}
+	}
+
+	policies := c.buildHashPolicies()
+	for _, p := range policies {
+		if err := p.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash policy validation failed: %w", err)
+		}
+	}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+	if spec.ConsistentHash.Disable != nil && *spec.ConsistentHash.Disable {
+		if len(spec.ConsistentHash.Headers) > 0 ||
+			len(spec.ConsistentHash.Cookies) > 0 ||
+			len(spec.ConsistentHash.QueryParameters) > 0 ||
+			len(spec.ConsistentHash.FilterState) > 0 ||
+			spec.ConsistentHash.SourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set in consistentHash")
+		}
+		ir.disable = true
+		out.consistentHash = ir
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ir.headers = deduplicateHeaders(spec.ConsistentHash.Headers)
+	ir.cookies = deduplicateCookies(spec.ConsistentHash.Cookies)
+	ir.queryParameters = deduplicateQueryParameters(spec.ConsistentHash.QueryParameters)
+	ir.filterState = deduplicateFilterState(spec.ConsistentHash.FilterState)
+	if spec.ConsistentHash.SourceIP != nil {
+		ir.sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: spec.ConsistentHash.SourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}

+func (c *consistentHashIR) buildHashPolicies() []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	// 1. When consistentHash is set (even as empty {}), the RouteAction must include hash_policy entries.
+	// If no sub-fields are specified, default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false.
+	if len(c.headers) == 0 && len(c.cookies) == 0 && len(c.queryParameters) == 0 && len(c.filterState) == 0 && c.sourceIP == nil {
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: false,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	policies := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0)
+
+	// Canonical type order: headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: headerPolicy,
+			},
+		}
+		if h.Terminal != nil && *h.Terminal {
+			hp.Terminal = true
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, ck := range c.cookies {
+		cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: ck.Name,
+		}
+		if ck.Path != nil {
+			cookiePolicy.Path = *ck.Path
+		}
+		if ck.TTL != nil {
+			ttl, _ := parseCookieTTL(*ck.TTL)
+			cookiePolicy.Ttl = ttl
+		}
+		if len(ck.Attributes) > 0 {
+			cookiePolicy.Attributes = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, len(ck.Attributes))
+			for i, attr := range ck.Attributes {
+				cookiePolicy.Attributes[i] = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+			},
+		}
+		if ck.Terminal != nil && *ck.Terminal {
+			hp.Terminal = true
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters
+	for _, q := range c.queryParameters {
+		queryPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+			Name: q.Name,
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: queryPolicy,
+			},
+		}
+		if q.Terminal != nil && *q.Terminal {
+			hp.Terminal = true
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState
+	for _, f := range c.filterState {
+		filterPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+			Key: f.Key,
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: filterPolicy,
+			},
+		}
+		if f.Terminal != nil && *f.Terminal {
+			hp.Terminal = true
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIP
+	if c.sourceIP != nil {
+		sourcePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+			SourceIp: true,
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: sourcePolicy,
+			},
+		}
+		if c.sourceIP.Terminal != nil && *c.sourceIP.Terminal {
+			hp.Terminal = true
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	return policies
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p2 == nil || p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.Clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Both p1 and p2 have consistentHash.
+	high := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	low := p2.spec.consistentHash
+	if opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableDeepMerge || opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableShallowMerge {
+		high = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		low = p1.spec.consistentHash
+	}
+
+	// When disable is true, no hash policies are produced and any inherited from broader-scoped policies are suppressed.
+	if high.disable {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+		if high == p2.spec.consistentHash {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	if low.disable {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = high.Clone()
+		if high == p2.spec.consistentHash {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Neither is disabled.
+	// Array fields must be unioned across both policies with the higher-priority policy's entries first,
+	// deduplicated by key. The merged result must be re-sorted into canonical type order.
+	// The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+	merged := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         false,
+		headers:         unionHeaders(high.headers, low.headers),
+		cookies:         unionCookies(high.cookies, low.cookies),
+		queryParameters: unionQueryParameters(high.queryParameters, low.queryParameters),
+		filterState:     unionFilterState(high.filterState, low.filterState),
+		sourceIP:        nil,
+	}
+	if high.sourceIP != nil {
+		merged.sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: high.sourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	p1.spec.consistentHash = merged
+	mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+}

+func parseCookieTTL(ttlStr string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if ttlStr == "" {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	// Try Go duration format first
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl cannot be negative: %s", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(d), nil
+	}
+	// Try plain integer seconds
+	if sec, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if sec < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl cannot be negative: %s", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(sec) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl: %q, must be Go duration format (e.g. 1h30m) or integer seconds (e.g. 3600)", ttlStr)
+}
